goldenCandidates.title: Member session bypasses the admin guard
goldenCandidates.description: Trigger: session is present with role member; !session is false, so !session && role !== admin evaluates false, the blocking throw is skipped, and deleteUser continues. Invariant: only admin sessions may delete users. Impact: the member reaches deletion through deleteUser.
goldenCandidates.suggestion: Reject when the session is absent or the role is not admin.

evidenceRequests.reason: Confirm that a present session can have the non-admin member role.

goldenCandidates.title: Member sessions are blocked by the admin guard
goldenCandidates.description: Trigger: session is present with role member; !session && role !== admin evaluates true and the blocking throw executes. Invariant: non-admin member sessions are blocked by the guard. Impact: the member cannot reach deletion through deleteUser.

evidenceRequests.reason: Confirm that member is a valid role before evaluating the guard.

goldenCandidates.title: External retention policy may be violated
goldenCandidates.description: Trigger: an admin calls deleteUser. Invariant: an external retention policy requires a seven-day delay. Impact: immediate deletion violates that retention policy.

verificationExpectations.rationale: The guard expression and Session role union directly establish the member-session authorization bypass.
The conjunction short-circuits for a present session, directly contradicting the claim that members are blocked.
The frozen fixture contains no retention-policy contract from which the claim could be established or disproven.
